findings.title: The anchor regex also matches `<abbr>`, `<article>`, `<audio>` and other non-anchor tags, so the sanitizer skips them whenever the English source contains the same tag
findings.description: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is `</?a[^>]*>`, which matches any tag whose name starts with `a`, not only `<a>`. `santizeAnchors` (lines 150-162) removes every match that is identical to the English tag at the same position (line 155), so those tags never reach the sanitizer. Example: the English value `Some <abbr title="x">text</abbr>` is verified against itself. Both tags match and are removed, leaving `Some text`, which sanitizes to itself, so no message is produced. `POLICY_SOME_HTML` (lines 58-61) does not allow `abbr`, so this should be flagged. A translation that reuses the same tag also passes. No shipped bundle currently contains such a tag (grep found none), so the bypass is latent, but it is a false negative in the gate.

findings.title: The mismatch-message builder can throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` when the common prefix and suffix overlap
findings.description: The prefix loop (lines 102-105) and the suffix loop (lines 106-109) are each bounded only by the two string lengths, not by each other. They can overlap, and then `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` gets begin greater than end. Input: an English value with no HTML (so `POLICY_NO_HTML`) and a translation `<b><1>`. The sanitizer drops `<b>` and keeps `<1>`, as the comment at line 94 describes. That gives `value = "<b><1>"` and `sanitized = "<1>"`, so start=1 and end=3, and `sanitized.substring(1, 0)` throws. Nothing catches it in `verifySafeHtml` or `verify()`, which catch only `IOException`. The exception aborts `ThemeVerifierMojo` (`ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51`) with a raw stack trace, so the build fails without the collected messages and the remaining files are not checked.

findings.title: The admin-ui English bundle now uses MessageFormat placeholders in a file that i18next interpolates with `{{n}}`
findings.description: The diff changes `error-invalid-multivalued-size` from `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` to `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` plus a `{2,choice,...}` clause. The admin UI loads this bundle through i18next (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:16-18`), which substitutes only `{{name}}` placeholders. In this file, line 3138 is the only single-brace placeholder (a grep for `[^{]\{[0-9]\}[^}]` matches only that line), so the key would render with literal `{0}`, `{1}` and `{2,choice,...}`. The same change appears in `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188`. That bundle has 25 `{{n}}` placeholders, and its loader (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:27-29`) is also i18next. The server does not rewrite placeholders when it serves these bundles. MessageFormat syntax is right for the server-rendered bundles, which go through `java.text.MessageFormat`, but not for the JS bundles. I could not trace which UI component renders this key, so the user-visible impact depends on that path.

findings.title: The Lithuanian account `totpStep1` now contains Italian text
findings.description: The new value `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, and it matches the `it` bundle's wording. The neighbouring Lithuanian lines are Lithuanian, so Lithuanian users see Italian in this step. The English source is `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:`, so this line needs a Lithuanian translation of that.

findings.title: The Lithuanian login `loginTotpStep1` now contains Italian text
findings.description: This is the same copy-paste error as the account bundle. The new value `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian. It is rendered by `login-config-totp.ftl:10`, so Lithuanian users see it on the login TOTP setup page.

findings.title: The Simplified Chinese account `totpStep1` uses Traditional characters
findings.description: The new value `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional forms (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The other zh_CN lines are Simplified, for example `loginTotpStep1` at `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:123` (`在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`). Simplified-Chinese users see Traditional script in this step. The line should be Simplified, for example `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.
